item.title: Target (Favorite Day): SPOTTED: Favorite Day Peppermint Candy Cane Milk for Elves
item.description: Now there’s milk for elves. Of course, there’s the return of milk for Santa. But what about milk for the reindeer? Mrs. Claus? The folks who dig up the lumps of coal? (Spotted by Robbie at Target.) (Via The Impulsive Buy)

item.title: Stop Buying Boring Steak: This Online Butcher Has Much Better Plans for You
item.description: Wondering why you can never emulate that perfect steakhouse dinner at home? It could be because of where you’re buying your beef. Crowd Cow is an online butcher that is rethinking how we shop for cuts of meat, specializing in premium meats, specialty cuts, and high-quality ingredients sourced directly from farmers and producers around the world. (Via Sporked)

item.title: Forget Boring Tea Bags: This Subscription Brings the Good Stuff to Your Door
item.description: It’s easy to fall into the same boring routine when it comes to caffeine consumption. You’ve got your go-to grocery store tea bags that get the job done energy-wise, but what about a blend of something you’d never even thought to try and end up loving? That’s the idea behind Art of Tea’s Tea of the Month Club. (Via Sporked)

item.title: Heinz Is Releasing The Weirdest New Product Of 2026
item.description: We’ve got a buzzer beater! Just when you thought you wouldn’t see the release of any more weird products from food brands this year, Heinz went and got one in at the last second. And we have thoughts about it. What’s the product? Napkins made from football jersey material. Why? Well, I wish I had a good answer to this question. (Via Sporked)

item.title: Every Culver's Sandwich, Ranked Worst To Best
item.description: Some Culver's sandwiches sounded better on the menu than they tasted at home. I tried eight in one sitting and found out which ones I'd order over a burger. (Via Tasting Table)

item.title: Wendy's: Wendy’s Is Turning Its Frostys And Fries Into Holiday Gifts
item.description: I wonder how many times you have to visit a fast food restaurant before your family starts buying you its merchandise for Christmas. I imagine once the drive-thru staff know your order without having to ask, you’re probably a prime candidate. Well, Wendy’s has decided its most dedicated customers deserve something to unwrap this year. (Via Sporked)

item.title: IHOP Just Announced Its First Ever Collectible Mug
item.description: It’s not just you. Holiday collectibles are having a moment. Between blind boxes and collectible cups, they’ve even started to take over the food industry. They’re so prominent that one restaurant is joining in on the fun for the first time ever. Who’s the restaurant in question? None other than IHOP! IHOCHM The International House of Pancakes? (Via Sporked)

item.title: How To Grab Jamba’s Focker-In-Law Smoothie Deal
item.description: Thanksgiving week is bringing plenty of family gatherings, awkward conversations, and, apparently, a very funny smoothie deal. Jamba is joining the fun ahead of the release of Focker-in-Law, the latest movie in the Meet the Parents franchise. (Via Sporked)

item.title: Raising Cane's: Raising Cane’s Just Released Limited-Edition Elf On The Shelf Merch
item.description: Yes, Elf on the Shelf is still alive and kicking! Well, it’s not actually alive even if that is the theme of the trick that parents like to play on their kids. Anyway, the point is that people are still pulling hijinks with Elf on the Shelf and Raising Cane’s is coming out with the collaboration of the century to celebrate the little goof’s antics. (Via Sporked)

item.title: Spotted At Costco: This Fan-Favorite Smoothie Is Finally Back
item.description: Oh the wondrous minds that work at Costco. They’re always up to something. First they give us a product that we fall in love with, then they take it away, but then they give it right back to us. Very Trader Joe’s of them. But that’s the game we’re forced to play. (Via Sporked)
